describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of dry, sparsely grassed ground. Its hindquarters, torso, forequarters and limbs are those of a large tawny-brown felid with muscular legs and a long tail, while its head, neck, chest and back are covered in dense raptor-like plumage. The head has a hooked beak and a yellow eye, and two very large feathered wings are spread outward and upward from the upper back. The overall coloration is warm golden-brown and dark brown with cream patches on the neck and chest and a dark tuft at the tip of the tail.

describe.description: A large four-legged creature standing in right profile with wings raised, combining an eagle front with a lion rear. The head, neck, chest and large spread wings are feathered in golden-brown and dark brown like a raptor with a hooked beak, while the mid-body, four muscular legs and long slender tufted tail are furred in tawny tan like a big cat. It stands on four feline paws on a small patch of bare ground.
